findings.summary: CommandSpec.capabilities is normative but not enforced
findings.detail: _spec.py says capabilities are checked before dispatch and the mcp command declares ('mcp',), but no frontend/dispatcher consumes spec.capabilities. Either implement one explicit capability gate or remove/redefine the field so metadata does not promise behavior that does not exist. Resolved 2026-10-13 (round 33, R2-5 / F-32): the field is removed; a delegated command's missing part is reported when its entry point is imported, with its install hint.
_spec.py and registry.py direct maintainers to EXTENDING.md, but no such live document is present in the supplied _cli tree. Restore an extension contract document or remove/update those references.

findings.summary: Full runtime suite is limited by incomplete project-root integration around supplied config/utils
findings.detail: scikitplot.config and scikitplot.utils are now present in the supplied snapshot. The remaining non-_cli blockers are the absent top-level scikitplot package integration (no scikitplot/__init__.py, scikitplot._testing, root logger/show_config, or scikitplot.exceptions) plus no TOML writer backend. The full suite remains an unavailable release lane rather than an _cli-owned failure.
